test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All player are tall.

II. All tall are small.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some player are small.

II. No small is player.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
Statements:

I. All player are tall.

II. All tall are small.

The least possible Venn diagram:

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6e33653a9980b873c56c74484d4c318aa752787446a6102fcb07352e10c13bf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some player are small. - **True **(Because All player are tall and All tall are small, so Some player are also small)

II. No small is player. - **False **(Because All player are tall and All tall are small, so Some player are small)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**".
